subject: english
question:
The sentence given below has spelling errors. Select the sentence without spelling errors.

Let us appriciate, support and contribute our might to the promotional efforts of the community in this direction.

options.text: Let us appriciate, support and contribute our might to the promotional efforts of the comunity in this direction.
Let us appreciate, suport and contribute our might to the promotional efforts of the community in this direction.
Let us appriciate, support and contribute our might to the promotion all efforts of the community in this direction.
Let us appreciate, support and contribute our might to the promotional efforts of the community in this direction.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appreciate"** means to recognize the full worth of something; to be grateful for something. (सराहना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **We should appreciate the efforts of our team members.
 
 
 
• **"support" **refers to bearing all or part of the weight of something; holding up. (समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She always supports her friends in times of need.
 
 
 
• **"promotional" **means relating to the publicizing of a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness. (प्रचारात्मक)
 
 
• **Example: **The company launched a promotional campaign for its new product.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "comunity" is a misspelling of "community". (समुदाय)

 
 
• **Example:** The community gathered to celebrate the festival.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "suport" is a misspelling of "support". (समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She always supports her friends in times of need.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "promotion all" should be "promotional". (प्रचारात्मक)
 
 
• **Example:** The company launched a promotional campaign for its new product.
